canonical_name: Hartman-Grobman local topological linearization theorem (exact source variant open)
literal_source_claim_zh: 双曲平衡点的局部线性化
literal_source_claim_en: Local linearization of a hyperbolic equilibrium.
statement_blocker: The catalogue gives no citation and does not fix the state-space generality, vector-field domain and regularity, local flow and time domain, hyperbolicity encoding, neighborhood/homeomorphism data, conjugacy orientation and parametrization, or the continuous-flow versus discrete-map boundary. Hartman 1960 Theorem (II) is an inspected primary candidate with an explicit C2 hypothesis, while a modern candidate uses different conventions. Selecting or generalizing either without review would invent source identity and proposition-changing mathematics.
domain_and_universes: Prospective real finite-dimensional phase space and an autonomous local vector field near a hyperbolic equilibrium; exact dimension, Lean universes, Euclidean versus coordinate-free model, open domain, equilibrium translation, and flow/time representation remain open.
conclusion: Prospective family only: the nonlinear local flow near a hyperbolic equilibrium is topologically conjugate, with the selected time-parametrization convention, to the flow of its derivative. Exact neighborhoods, maps, time quantifiers, orientation, and regularity remain open.

primary_candidate_not_credited.source: Philip Hartman, A lemma in the theory of structural stability of differential equations, Proceedings of the American Mathematical Society 11(4), 1960, DOI 10.1090/S0002-9939-1960-0121542-7
primary_candidate_not_credited.system: x' = T x + F(x) near zero in a real Euclidean space
primary_candidate_not_credited.hypotheses: F=o(|x|), F is C2 near zero, and every eigenvalue gamma_j of T has nonzero real part
primary_candidate_not_credited.conclusion: a continuous one-to-one neighborhood map conjugates the nonlinear solution transformations T^t to u |-> exp(T t)u while preserving path parametrization
primary_candidate_not_credited.status: inspected primary candidate and proof, but not catalogue-selected, binder-complete in the dossier, audited for Hartman-specific errata or corrigenda, or independently reviewed; H1 discovery evidence only

modern_candidate_not_credited.source: Gerald Teschl, Ordinary Differential Equations and Dynamical Systems, Graduate Studies in Mathematics 140, AMS, 2012, DOI 10.1090/gsm/140
modern_candidate_not_credited.system: a differentiable vector field with zero as a hyperbolic fixed point
modern_candidate_not_credited.conclusion: a local homeomorphism phi(x)=x+h(x) conjugates exp(tA) to the nonlinear flow Phi_t
modern_candidate_not_credited.status: inspected authoritative modern candidate together with its official errata, but not catalogue-selected or independently reviewed; proof-relevant errata on pages 265, 266, and 268 require an incorporated mapping, and the source does not license silently weakening the primary candidate's C2 premise
